title.en: A shift in the qigong room

tagline.zh: 八個動作，和一口不能憋的氣
tagline.en: Eight movements, and one breath you must never hold

desc.zh: 課前量血壓問病史，課中看誰臉色不對；把「養生」講成中醫的道理，不講成保證。
desc.en: Blood pressure and history before class, watching faces during it; explain wellbeing as TCM's reasoning, never as a promise.

desc.zh: 口令、示範、修正動作是你的。動作做小一點沒關係，呼吸不能憋。
desc.en: Counts, demonstrations and corrections are yours. Smaller movements are fine; held breath is not.

role.zh: 中醫師，導引功法指導（師傅）

about.zh: 七十歲還能單腿站很久的中醫師。說話很慢，他說說話也是在調息。名言：「動作是形，呼吸是氣，心靜是神。三調缺一，就只是體操。」
about.en: Seventy, and can still stand on one leg for ages. Speaks slowly, because speaking is breathing too. His line: movement is form, breath is qi, a quiet mind is spirit; miss one of the three and it is only gymnastics.

about.zh: 前現代舞者，口令像在唱歌。會走到學員背後，輕輕把聳起來的肩膀按下去。
about.en: A former contemporary dancer whose counts sound like singing. Walks behind students and gently presses hunched shoulders back down.

about.zh: 上課前量血壓的人。量完會在名牌上貼小圓點：綠、黃、紅。學員都怕拿到紅點。
about.en: Takes blood pressures before class and sticks a dot on each name badge: green, amber or red. Everyone dreads a red dot.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。六十六歲剛退休的會計師，高血壓吃藥中。做什麼都很認真，認真到會憋氣。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. A sixty-six-year-old accountant, just retired, on medicine for blood pressure. Earnest about everything, earnest enough to hold his breath.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。三十八歲，半年來晚上腦子停不下來。身心科在追蹤、吃著助眠藥，想學一點「自己能做的事」。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Thirty-eight; for months her mind will not switch off at night. Followed by a psychiatrist and on a sleep medicine, she wants to learn something she can do herself.

about.zh: 管黃伯的藥盒管了三十年。今天早上那格忘了的藥，她比誰都在意。
about.en: Has managed his pill box for thirty years. Today's forgotten morning slot bothers her more than anyone.

plain.zh: 宋代流傳至今的八節導引功法，動作柔和、站著就能做。每一式都有對應臟腑的說法，例如「兩手托天理三焦」。
plain.en: An eight-section qigong handed down since the Song dynasty; gentle, done standing. Each section is linked to organs, as in “both hands hold up the sky to regulate the triple burner”.

plain.zh: 調身（姿勢動作）、調息（呼吸）、調心（專注放鬆）。中醫認為三者同時到位，才是氣功，不只是體操。
plain.en: Regulating the body (posture and movement), the breath and the mind (calm attention). TCM holds that only with all three together is it qigong rather than gymnastics.

plain.zh: 讓呼吸變得細、勻、深、長，自然而不勉強。初學只要「不憋氣、跟著動作」就好。
plain.en: Making the breath fine, even, deep and long, natural and unforced. For beginners: never hold it, and let it follow the movement.

plain.zh: 閉住氣用力，胸腔壓力升高，血壓先衝高、再掉下來，會頭暈、臉紅。高血壓與心臟病的人特別要避免。
plain.en: Holding the breath while straining raises pressure in the chest; blood pressure spikes then drops, bringing dizziness and a flushed face. Especially to be avoided with hypertension or heart disease.

plain.zh: 練功的總原則：肌肉放鬆、心裡安靜、動作和呼吸都順其自然，不追求做到最大。
plain.en: The guiding rule of practice: muscles loose, mind quiet, movement and breath allowed to happen, never forced to the maximum.

plain.zh: 把注意力輕輕放在下腹部肚臍下方的區域（氣海、關元附近）。中醫認為能引氣下行、讓心安定。
plain.en: Resting attention lightly on the lower belly below the navel, around Qihai and Guanyuan. TCM holds that it draws qi downwards and settles the mind.

plain.zh: 中醫的一種證型：頭脹、面紅、易怒、眩暈，常和高血壓的表現重疊。練功時宜引氣向下，不宜意守頭頂。
plain.en: A TCM pattern of a full head, flushed face, irritability and dizziness, often overlapping with hypertension. In practice, draw qi downwards and avoid resting attention on the crown.

plain.zh: 中醫認為長期壓力讓肝氣鬱結化火，火擾心神，於是煩躁、失眠、口乾、舌紅苔黃。
plain.en: TCM holds that long stress binds the liver qi until it turns to fire, and the fire disturbs the heart's spirit: restlessness, insomnia, dry mouth, a red tongue with a yellow coat.

term.en: both hands reach for the feet

plain.zh: 八段錦第六式：向前彎腰、雙手沿腿後側往下。頭會低於心臟，高血壓控制不好或頭暈的人改成半彎、手扶大腿。
plain.en: The sixth Baduanjin section: bending forward, hands sliding down the backs of the legs. The head drops below the heart, so with poorly controlled blood pressure or dizziness, bend halfway with hands on the thighs.

plain.zh: 八段錦第七式：馬步出拳、瞪眼。最容易讓認真的人憋氣用力，口令要提醒「拳出時吐氣」。
plain.en: The seventh section: horse stance, punching, eyes wide. The one most likely to make earnest students hold their breath and strain, so the count reminds them to breathe out as the fist goes out.

plain.zh: 頭頂正中，兩耳尖連線的中點。中醫認為諸陽之會；練功時頭頂「虛領」，像被一根線輕輕提著。
plain.en: The top of the head, midway between the ear tips. In TCM reasoning the meeting of all the yang; in practice the crown is lifted lightly, as if by a thread.

plain.zh: 和醫師原本的治療一起使用、而不是取代它的方法。功法對睡眠、血壓、情緒可能有幫助，但不要自己停藥。
plain.en: Something used alongside a doctor's treatment rather than instead of it. Qigong may help sleep, blood pressure and mood, but never stop medicines on your own.

text.zh: 防滑墊排成三排，前面是一面大鏡子。每個位置旁邊都放一張有扶手的椅子，頭暈的人隨時能坐。
text.en: Non-slip mats in three rows facing a big mirror. Beside every place stands a chair with arms, so anyone dizzy can sit at once.

text.zh: 綠點照常練；黃點做修改版、站在椅子旁；紅點今天先休息、找醫師。圓點是給教練看的，不是給學員羞愧的。
text.en: Green: practise as usual. Amber: the modified version, standing by a chair. Red: rest today and see the doctor. The dots are for the coach to see, not for the student to be ashamed of.

text.zh: 她用專案管理的格式記睡眠：幾點上床、醒幾次、早上幾分精神。下次回診，她要帶給身心科醫師看。
text.en: She keeps her sleep log like a project tracker: bedtime, wakings, a morning energy score. She will take it to her psychiatrist next visit.

text.zh: 調身：頭頂虛領、沉肩墜肘、含胸拔背、膝微屈不過腳尖，重心在兩腳之間。調息：自然呼吸為先，熟練後配合動作，起吸落呼、開吸合呼，絕不憋氣。調心：注意力放在動作與呼吸上，雜念來了不趕它，回到呼吸就好。初學者先求調身正確、呼吸不憋，「心」會慢慢跟上。三調一起，中醫認為才能「形氣神」合一。
text.en: Body: crown lifted, shoulders and elbows sinking, chest soft and back long, knees softly bent never past the toes, weight between both feet. Breath: natural first; once fluent, link it to movement, breathing in as you rise or open and out as you sink or close, never holding. Mind: attention on movement and breath; when thoughts arrive, do not chase them away, just return to the breath. Beginners first get the posture right and the breath unheld; the mind follows. With all three together, TCM speaks of form, qi and spirit becoming one.

text.zh: 高血壓控制不好、眩暈：第六式改半彎手扶大腿、頭不低於心臟；第七式拳出吐氣、不咬牙；轉頭動作慢、幅度小。膝關節退化：馬步站高一點。平衡不好：站在椅子旁，第八式「背後七顛」改成腳跟輕抬不落地震。骨質疏鬆：避免快速彎腰扭轉。課前有胸痛、劇烈頭痛、視力模糊、單側無力、喘不過氣，今天不練，先就醫。
text.en: Uncontrolled blood pressure or dizziness: section six becomes a half bend with hands on the thighs, head never below the heart; section seven breathes out on the punch, no clenched jaw; head turns slow and small. Worn knees: a higher horse stance. Poor balance: stand by a chair, and section eight lifts the heels gently without the jolt. Osteoporosis: no quick bending with twisting. Chest pain, a severe headache, blurred vision, one-sided weakness or breathlessness before class: no practice today; see a doctor first.

name.en: Why the breath must never be held

text.zh: 憋氣用力時胸腔壓力升高，回心的血變少，接著血壓急升；放氣那一刻血壓又掉，就會頭暈、眼前發黑。高血壓、心臟病、青光眼、剛開刀的人尤其危險。中醫說「氣以順為貴」，練功講的是「調息」，不是「閉氣」。教練的口令要把呼吸講出來：「推出去，吐氣。」
text.en: Straining with a held breath raises pressure in the chest, less blood returns to the heart, then the pressure surges; on release it falls again, bringing dizziness and greying vision. It is especially risky with hypertension, heart disease, glaucoma or recent surgery. TCM says qi is precious when it flows; practice is about regulating the breath, not shutting it in. A coach's counts must say the breath out loud: “push out, and breathe out.”

name.en: Practice supports, it does not replace

text.zh: 研究顯示太極、八段錦等功法對睡眠品質、血壓、情緒與平衡可能有幫助，但幅度因人而異。正確的位置是輔助療法：和醫師的治療並行、記錄變化、帶回門診討論。不建議自行停用降血壓藥或助眠藥，有些藥突然停會反彈。紅旗：持續失眠伴情緒低落或想傷害自己、胸痛、劇烈頭痛、單側無力，都要轉診，不是多練就好。
text.en: Studies suggest practices like taiji and Baduanjin may help sleep quality, blood pressure, mood and balance, though effects vary from person to person. Their rightful place is complementary therapy: alongside the doctor's treatment, changes recorded and taken back to clinic. Do not stop blood-pressure or sleep medicines on your own; some rebound if stopped suddenly. Red flags such as persistent insomnia with low mood or thoughts of self-harm, chest pain, severe headache or one-sided weakness need referral, not more practice.

note.en: Before class: three regulations, the room

guide.zh: 到墊區跟師傅準備場地
guide.en: Set up the mats with the master

lines.zh: 天剛亮，導引室的窗開了一條縫。鍾師傅單腿站在鏡子前，像一隻鷺鷥。
lines.en: First light; the practice-room window is open a crack. Master Chung stands on one leg before the mirror like a heron.

lines.zh: 練功先調三件事。哪三件？
lines.en: Practice regulates three things first. Which three?

lines.zh: 調身、調息、調心。三調。
lines.en: Body, breath and mind. The three regulations.

lines.zh: 還有第零件：場地。墊子防滑、椅子有扶手、水放手邊。先把場地準備好。
lines.en: And a zeroth: the room. Non-slip mats, chairs with arms, water within reach. Prepare the room first.

post.zh: 每張墊子旁邊一張椅子。上次有阿姨轉頭轉到暈，就是靠椅子接住的。
post.en: A chair beside every mat. Last time an auntie turned her head till she was dizzy, and a chair caught her.

lines.zh: 今天十二位學員，十位綠點。黃伯黃點，血壓比平常高，他說早上的藥忘了吃。新來的佳慧綠點，她說是來治失眠的。
lines.en: Twelve students today, ten green. Uncle Huang amber: higher than usual, and he says he forgot his morning pill. Newcomer Chia-Hui is green; she says she's here for her insomnia.

lines.zh: 黃點的那位，你先去問。問症狀，不只看數字。
lines.en: Go and ask the amber one first. Ask about symptoms, not just the numbers.

note.zh: 黃伯黃點、佳慧舌紅苔黃
note.en: Uncle Huang amber; Chia-Hui red tongue

guide.en: Ask Uncle Huang how he is

lines.zh: 早上急著出門，藥盒那一格忘了。我太太一定會唸。不過我精神很好，可以練全套。
lines.en: Rushed out this morning and forgot that slot in the pill box. My wife will scold me. But I feel great; I can do the full set.

lines.zh: 黃伯，現在有沒有頭痛、胸悶、看東西模糊、手腳無力或麻？
lines.en: Uncle Huang, any headache now, chest tightness, blurred vision, weakness or numbness in your arms or legs?

lines.zh: 都沒有。就是脖子有點緊，臉有點熱。
lines.en: None. Just a tight neck and a warm face.

lines.zh: 頭脹面紅，中醫叫肝陽上亢。沒有紅旗，但血壓偏高、藥沒吃。你讓他怎麼練？
lines.en: A full head and flushed face: TCM calls it ascendant liver yang. No red flags, but his pressure is up and the pill is missed. How do you let him practise?

q.zh: 黃伯血壓偏高、漏服藥、沒有紅旗症狀。
q.en: Uncle Huang: pressure up, pill missed, no red-flag symptoms.

options.zh: 先坐著休息再量，穩定後做修改版
options.en: Rest, re-measure, then the modified set

why.zh: 休息後再量，漏服依醫師或藥師的指示處理。可以練，但第六式半彎、第七式吐氣、站在椅子旁。
why.en: Re-measure after rest, and handle the missed dose as his doctor or pharmacist advises. He can practise: half bend in section six, breathe out in section seven, a chair beside him.

options.zh: 照常練全套，運動會讓血壓降
options.en: Full set as usual; exercise lowers BP

why.zh: 規律運動長期有助血壓，但當下偏高時，彎腰頭低、憋氣用力會讓血壓衝更高。
why.en: Regular exercise helps blood pressure over time, but right now head-down bending and straining will push it higher still.

options.en: Tell him to take a double dose

why.zh: 漏服怎麼補要依醫囑，不能自己加倍。這不是導引室可以決定的事。
why.en: How to handle a missed dose is the prescriber's call; never double up. Not a decision for the qigong room.

post.zh: 好，我坐一下。……我太太會說「早就跟你講」。
post.en: Right, I'll sit. …My wife will say “I told you so.”

lines.zh: 半年了，晚上一閉眼腦子就開始跑專案進度。身心科有開藥，吃了能睡，可是我想學一點自己能做的。
lines.en: Six months now. I shut my eyes and my brain starts running project timelines. My psychiatrist prescribes something, and it works, but I want something I can do myself.

lines.zh: 伸舌頭給我們看看。看舌尖、舌色、舌苔。
lines.en: Show us your tongue. Look at the tip, the colour, the coat.

q.zh: 舌紅、舌尖更紅、苔薄黃。怎麼讀？
q.en: Red tongue, redder at the tip, thin yellow coat. How do you read it?

options.en: Red with yellow coat: heart-liver fire

why.zh: 中醫認為舌尖候心，舌尖紅主心火；苔黃主熱。長期壓力肝鬱化火、火擾心神，所以煩躁難眠。
why.en: In TCM reasoning the tip reflects the heart, a red tip means heart fire, and a yellow coat means heat. Long stress binds liver qi into fire that disturbs the spirit: restless and sleepless.

options.en: Pale with white coat: heart-spleen deficiency

why.zh: 心脾兩虛的失眠舌偏淡、苔白，人疲倦、多夢易醒。她的舌是紅的。
why.en: Heart-spleen deficiency insomnia shows a pale tongue and white coat, with fatigue and light, dreamy sleep. Hers is red.

why.zh: 瘀血舌色紫暗或有瘀點。她沒有。
why.en: Stasis shows a dusky purple tongue or spots. She has neither.

post.zh: 心肝火旺。八段錦裡哪一式，名字就叫去心火？
post.en: Heart and liver fire. Which Baduanjin section is named for clearing heart fire?

post.zh: 第五式，搖頭擺尾去心火。
post.en: The fifth: sway the head and swing the tail to clear heart fire.

lines.zh: 如果我每天練，是不是就可以把助眠藥停掉？我不想一直吃藥。
lines.en: If I practise every day, can I just stop the sleeping pills? I don't want to be on them forever.

q.zh: 佳慧想靠練功停掉助眠藥。
q.en: Chia-Hui wants practice to replace her sleep medicine.

options.zh: 練功當輔助，減藥和醫師討論

why.zh: 功法可能幫助入睡，是輔助療法。有些助眠藥突然停會反彈失眠或不適，減藥要和開藥的醫師一起規劃。
why.en: Practice may help her sleep: a complementary therapy. Some sleep medicines rebound if stopped suddenly, so any tapering is planned with the prescriber.

options.en: Yes, practice is more natural than pills

why.zh: 「自然」不等於可以取代。自行停藥可能反彈失眠，也會讓醫師失去判斷的依據。
why.en: Natural does not mean a replacement. Stopping on her own may rebound, and leaves her doctor without the facts.

options.zh: 練功對失眠沒用，別浪費時間
options.en: Practice won't help insomnia; don't bother

why.zh: 研究顯示功法可能改善睡眠品質。否定它會讓她失去一個安全、自己能做的方法。
why.en: Studies suggest practice may improve sleep quality. Dismissing it takes away a safe thing she can do herself.

post.zh: 好，那我把睡眠日記帶去給醫師看。我很會做表格。
post.en: OK, I'll take a sleep diary to my doctor. I'm very good at spreadsheets.

note.en: Eight sections, stance, Uncle Huang's held breath

lines.zh: 白板上的八式卡片被風吹亂了。前六式你幫我排回去，後兩式我來。
lines.en: The wind has scrambled the section cards on the board. Put the first six back; I'll do the last two.

q.en: The first six Baduanjin sections in order

steps.en: Hold up the sky: triple burner
Draw the bow to shoot the eagle
Raise one arm: spleen and stomach
Sway head and tail: heart fire

post.zh: 第七式攢拳怒目增氣力，第八式背後七顛百病消。全對，獎你站最前排。
post.en: Seven: clenched fists and glaring eyes. Eight: rise on the toes and drop. All correct; your prize is the front row.

lines.zh: 預備勢。兩腳與肩同寬，膝微屈不過腳尖，頭頂像被一根線提著。重心在兩腳正中。
lines.en: Ready stance. Feet shoulder-width, knees softly bent, never past the toes, crown lifted as if by a thread. Weight in the middle of both feet.

lines.zh: 鬆靜自然。不是站得多久，是站得多鬆。
lines.en: Relaxed, calm and natural. Not how long you stand; how loosely.

post.en: Who knew standing still was tiring.

lines.zh: 托天時吸氣、落下時吐氣。射鵰的時候眼睛看遠方手指，不是看鏡子裡的自己。
lines.en: Breathe in as you hold up the sky, out as you lower. When you draw the bow, look at your distant fingertip, not at yourself in the mirror.

lines.zh: 黃伯，第六式兩手攀足固腎腰，您半彎就好，手扶大腿，頭不要低過心臟。
lines.en: Uncle Huang, in section six, both hands reach for the feet, but you bend only halfway, hands on your thighs, head no lower than your heart.

post.zh: 教室安靜下來，只剩小葳的口令和十二個人的呼吸。
post.en: The room goes quiet: only Hsiao-Wei's counts and twelve people breathing.

lines.zh: 口令交給你，這是全班的調息。把呼吸說出來：「起，吸。落，吐。」慢一點，比你覺得的再慢一點。
lines.en: The counts are yours: breath regulation for the whole room. Say the breath out loud: “rise, in; sink, out.” Slower; slower than you think.

post.zh: 很好。全班的肩膀都掉下來了，這是口令最好的分數。
post.en: Good. Every shoulder in the room has dropped. That's the best score a count can get.

lines.zh: 第七式攢拳怒目。黃伯咬著牙、閉著氣，一拳一拳打得很用力。收拳時他晃了一下，臉紅到耳朵。
lines.en: Section seven, clenched fists. Uncle Huang grits his teeth and holds his breath, punching hard. As he draws back he sways, red to the ears.

lines.zh: 頭……有點脹，眼前一閃一閃。
lines.en: My head… feels full, things are flickering.

lines.zh: 血壓量到了，比早上更高。
lines.en: Got a reading: higher than this morning.

options.zh: 停練、坐下、自然呼吸、再量、問紅旗
options.en: Stop, sit, breathe easy, re-measure, ask red flags

why.zh: 憋氣用力讓血壓衝高。先坐下休息、放鬆呼吸、再量。若劇烈頭痛、胸痛、視力模糊不退、單側無力或說話不清，立刻急診。
why.en: Straining with a held breath spiked his pressure. Sit, rest, breathe easy, re-measure. A severe headache, chest pain, persisting blurred vision, one-sided weakness or slurred speech means emergency now.

options.en: Finish the class; relaxing will lower it

why.zh: 他有症狀。繼續做只會讓血壓再衝一次。
why.en: He has symptoms. Carrying on only spikes it again.

why.zh: 那是低血壓的姿勢。血壓高、頭脹的人坐著比較好。
why.en: That is the position for low pressure. With high pressure and a full head, sitting is better.

post.zh: ……好多了，眼睛不閃了。我剛剛是不是一直憋氣？
post.en: …Much better, the flickering's gone. Was I holding my breath the whole time?

post.zh: 從第一拳到最後一拳。下次拳出去的時候吐氣，像在吹蠟燭。
post.en: From the first punch to the last. Next time breathe out as the fist goes out, like blowing out a candle.

note.zh: 意守的位置：向下不向上
note.en: Where attention rests: down, not up

lines.zh: 早上你沒讓他先休息再量，也沒改動作。剛剛那一下如果接著做全彎腰、頭低過心臟，會更高。
lines.en: This morning you neither rested and re-measured him nor modified his set. Had a full head-down bend followed that punch, his pressure would have gone higher still.

lines.zh: 記住了。黃點：先休息、再量、再決定怎麼練。
lines.en: Noted. Amber dot: rest, re-measure, then decide how he practises.

lines.zh: 還好早上先坐了一下、第六式也只彎一半。不然剛剛應該更暈。
lines.en: Good thing I sat first this morning and only half-bent in section six. Otherwise I'd have been dizzier just now.

lines.zh: 修改版不是打折，是量身訂做。
lines.en: The modified set is not a discount; it is tailoring.

guide.en: Ask the master where to focus

lines.zh: 練功時注意力放哪裡，有講究。頭頂百會、下腹氣海、腳底湧泉。黃伯這種肝陽上亢的人，該守哪裡？
lines.en: Where attention rests in practice matters. Baihui at the crown, Qihai in the lower belly, Yongquan on the sole. For ascendant liver yang like Uncle Huang, where?

lines.zh: 守下面，氣海或湧泉。意守丹田，引氣向下，不守頭頂。
lines.en: Down low: Qihai or Yongquan. Attention at the dantian draws qi downwards; not the crown.

lines.zh: 圖上把三個點給我看。
lines.en: Show me all three on the figure.

post.zh: 百會要「虛領」，輕輕提著，不是把注意力全堆上去。頭本來就脹的人，越守越脹。
post.en: The crown is lifted lightly, not loaded with attention. Someone whose head already feels full only grows fuller.

lines.zh: 紀錄：課前血壓偏高、漏服；第七式憋氣後頭脹眼閃、血壓升高，休息後緩解，無神經學症狀。建議回家醫科追蹤血壓與用藥。
lines.en: Note: BP raised before class, missed dose; head fullness and flickering vision with a BP rise after straining in section seven, settled with rest, no neurological signs. Advise family-medicine follow-up of BP and medicines.

lines.zh: 再寫一行：下次課前藥吃了沒，美華要先問。
lines.en: One more line: before next class, Mei-Hua asks whether he took his pill.

guide.en: Give Uncle Huang a modified routine

lines.zh: 黃伯，回家練的版本：第六式半彎、第七式吐氣出拳、轉頭慢一點。站在椅子旁。不舒服就停。
lines.en: Uncle Huang, your home version: half bend in six, breathe out as you punch in seven, slow head turns. Stand by a chair. Stop if you feel unwell.

lines.zh: 我會貼在冰箱上。我太太會監督。
lines.en: I'll stick it on the fridge. My wife will supervise.

note.zh: 家屬：什麼時候要去急診
note.en: Family: when to go to emergency

sub.zh: 黃太太問：他今天在課上頭暈？
sub.en: Mrs Huang: he got dizzy in class?

lines.zh: 他回來說他今天「憋氣憋到眼睛閃」。藥我已經照醫師交代處理了。他還說要一天練三次。
lines.en: He came home saying he “held his breath till his eyes flickered”. I've dealt with the pill as the doctor told us. And now he wants to practise three times a day.

lines.zh: 一天一兩次、慢慢來就好，重點是不憋氣。這週請帶他回家醫科量血壓。
lines.en: Once or twice a day, gently, is plenty; the key is never holding his breath. Please take him to his family doctor for a BP check this week.

lines.zh: 那什麼情況要直接去急診？
lines.en: And when do we go straight to emergency?

lines.zh: 劇烈頭痛、胸痛、單邊手腳無力或麻、講話不清、看東西模糊不退，馬上叫救護車，不要等。
lines.en: A severe headache, chest pain, weakness or numbness on one side, slurred speech, or blurred vision that doesn't clear: call an ambulance at once. Don't wait.

lines.zh: 好，我寫在藥盒蓋子上。
lines.en: Right. I'll write it on the pill-box lid.

guide.en: The Six Sounds: xu he hu si chui xi

lines.zh: 晚班練六字訣。佳慧心肝火旺，你說，哪兩個字對應肝和心？
lines.en: The evening class does the Six Healing Sounds. Chia-Hui has heart and liver fire: which two sounds go with liver and heart?

lines.zh: 噓對肝、呵對心。吐氣時發聲，吸氣時自然。
lines.en: Xu for the liver, he for the heart. Sound on the out-breath; breathe in naturally.

lines.zh: 噓——。……我第一次聽到自己吐氣這麼長。
lines.en: Xuuu… …I've never heard myself breathe out that long.

post.zh: 睡前做幾輪就好，燈調暗，手機放到另一個房間。
post.en: A few rounds before bed is enough. Lights low, phone in another room.

lines.zh: 早上你說可以停藥，所以昨晚我就沒吃了。結果整夜沒睡，心一直跳。
lines.en: You said this morning I could stop, so I skipped my pill last night. Didn't sleep at all, my heart kept racing.

lines.zh: 早上那一題，要改回來。佳慧，藥的事請先和你的醫師談，不要突然停。練功放在藥的旁邊，不是藥的位置。
lines.en: We need to correct this morning's answer. Chia-Hui, talk to your doctor before changing the medicine, never stop suddenly. Practice sits beside the medicine, not in its place.

lines.zh: 對不起，是我說錯了。我幫你寫一張給醫師的紀錄。
lines.en: I'm sorry, I got that wrong. I'll write a note for your doctor.

lines.zh: 睡眠日記我做好了，有一欄叫「練功」。下個月回診，醫師會看到數字。
lines.en: My sleep diary's ready, with a column called “practice”. At next month's visit my doctor will see the numbers.

lines.zh: 這就是中西整合：你練、他看，數字說話。
lines.en: That is integration: you practise, he reviews, and the numbers speak.

note.en: The master: the art of one breath

lines.zh: 今天你學的最重要的動作，是哪一式？
lines.en: What was the most important movement you learned today?

lines.zh: 不是八式裡的任何一式。是吐氣。
lines.en: None of the eight. Breathing out.

lines.zh: 形可以小，氣不能憋，心要回來。明天見。
lines.en: The form may be small; the breath must never be held; the mind must come home. See you tomorrow.

sub.en: A few rounds of xu; heading to bed

lines.zh: 訊息：「噓了幾輪，手機放客廳了。腦子裡的專案還在跑，但是跑得比較慢。晚安。」
lines.en: Message: “Did a few rounds of xu, phone's in the living room. The projects are still running in my head, but slower. Good night.”

lines.zh: 回她：慢就好。晚安，記得睡眠日記。
lines.en: Reply: slower is good. Good night, and fill in the diary.

sub.zh: 八個動作，一口吐出去的氣
sub.en: Eight movements, and one long breath out
